quote: First off, we ain’t “part of regular Virginia.” We *divorced* Virginia. And we had the best reason in the whole, entire history of this country to do it. Back in 1861, when the rest of Virginia voted to secede from the Union to go fight for the right to keep people in chains, the folks out here in these mountains said, “Absolutely not.”
